title: Normalized input message
description: Shape every trigger (Gmail or web form) is converted to before the AI step.

message_id.description: Gmail message id, or the form submission id. Generated as form-<timestamp>-<random> if a form sends none. Used to skip duplicates.

body.description: Trimmed plain text, cut to 4000 characters to cap AI cost.

received_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp. Filled with the processing time if missing.
